thread:
Maya: quick heads-up — for the SMB pilot we have a customer asking for an SLA add-on: p95 latency guarantee 300ms for text-gen endpoints. What do we need to ship before we can sell this? Specs, pricing, and launch criteria. Thoughts?

Jonas: rough infra call — for hosted we'd need a small dedicated warm pool + KV cache pinning per-tenant. Ops cost looks nontrivial. Also need enforced sequence-length and concurrency caps.

Priya: agree. We need per-tenant telemetry (p50/p95/p99 histograms), and automated rollback if SLOs slip. Also consider synthetic probes from customer region.

Evan: can we do a soft-SLA first? e.g., service credits on misses rather than full financial SLA. Much easier to operate early. :thinking_face:

Grace: customer preference: predictable pricing. They want a flat monthly surcharge + overage cap. Will push back on pure per-token models.

billing-bot: quick resource estimate for 1k sustained qps pilot:
````json
{
  "gpu_hours": "~120/mo",
  "expected_oversub": "~20%",
  "ops_hours": "~40/mo"
}
````

Maya: @billing-bot can you convert that to $ and a per-tenant price assuming 5 pilot customers?

billing-bot: rough $ calc: $18,000 GPU + $4,000 ops + $1,200 infra = $23,200/mo. If split across 5 tenants => ~$4,640 base/tenant + overage pricing. (very rough)

Jonas: technical constraints: per-tenant batching isolation, KV cache pin (no sharing), and pin model variant (quantized variants can hurt tail latency). Need a canary degrade path to best-effort gen.

Priya: suggested launch criteria: 1) sustained end-to-end p95 <300ms for >=95% of queries over 14 days, 2) automated rollback on sustained miss (>5m continuous or >5% failed windows), 3) observability + runbook + customer facing SLA doc.

Evan: implementation phases idea:
- phase 0: telemetry & synth probes (2w)
- phase 1: soft-SLA (credits, pilot pricing, 2-4w)
- phase 2: financially-backed SLA with reserved capacity & contract (4-6w)

Grace: pricing proposal for pilot: base $5,000/mo + $0.02 per 1k tokens overage. Offer 20% discount for 12mo commit. Include monthly spending cap option.

Maya: action items — Jonas: scope infra changes + estimate hours/cost; Priya: draft telemetry, alerting rules, and rollback runbook; Evan: phased rollout plan + customer-facing fallback copy; Grace: draft commercial term + sample price table. Sync Tues 10am. :calendar:

Jonas: I'll put up a short tech spec by EOD.

Priya: will prototype alert rules + a minimal dashboard by Fri.

Evan: will draft rollout timeline and fallback UX text.

Grace: will build the customer proposal template and attach the price table.

Maya: thanks — tagging @legal for T&C and SLA credit language check.

legal-bot: noted. Will review standard SLA credit language and return comments within 48h.
